expectations.text: Selects the exact pinned Boot 3.5 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, and verifies 3.2.5 to fixture-stable 3.5.12.
expectations.evidence: Command `mvn -U org.openrewrite.maven:rewrite-maven-plugin:6.46.1:run ... UpgradeSpringBoot_3_5 --define rewrite.exportDatatables=true`; '[SIM] The parent is now 3.5.12 in the effective POM, which matches the verified stable target' (from 3.2.5).

expectations.text: Derives smoke checks beyond the documented readiness URL from code/config: /shop context path, /v3/api-docs, Swagger UI, product endpoints, and the static index page.
expectations.evidence: Step 1.5 code/config inspection; S1-S8 'derived ... from the code inspection': /shop context, S2 /shop/v1/products, S3 /shop/ and app.js, S6 /shop/v3/api-docs, S7 /shop/swagger-ui/index.html.

expectations.text: Smoke tests include a security check: unauthenticated write rejected and an authenticated write using scripts/get-token.sh, with cleanup of created data.
expectations.evidence: S4 unauthenticated POST → 401; S5 'TOKEN=$(scripts/get-token.sh admin admin), then POST, GET, and DELETE' (the DELETE cleans up the created product).

expectations.text: REST checks assert response content (e.g. 3 seeded products / expected fields), not only HTTP status.
expectations.evidence: S2 '200; 3 seeded products'; S3 '"Shop Catalog" page'; S6 'paths match the pre-upgrade baseline'.

expectations.text: Detects the api-docs 500 / Swagger UI failure as a stage failure despite passing build and readiness, fixes springdoc, and reruns the build plus the smoke test.
expectations.evidence: 'S6 fails: GET /shop/v3/api-docs returns 500 ... S7 fails'; 'only the smoke test revealed it'; springdoc 2.3.0 → 2.8.9; 3.7 `mvn clean verify` passes, 3.8 'mvn spring-boot:run, then S1–S8 ... All pass'.

expectations.text: Runs a smoke test after the test-only mvn clean verify item (by starting the app) and after the Approach B image is started via Compose, not only after Approach A.
expectations.evidence: Approach B smoke is present (3.9 'Compose ... up -d, then S1–S8'), but no smoke test is associated with the test-only `mvn clean verify` item: the V1 row only says 'All unit and integration tests pass', and S1-S8 are defined only 'for each run approach'. Approach A happens to follow verify in the scenario order, so this is coincidental rather than a deliberate post-verify smoke run.

expectations.text: Captures or compares against a pre-upgrade baseline (e.g. OpenAPI document) or explicitly states why it could not.
expectations.evidence: Pre-upgrade baseline: `curl -s .../shop/v3/api-docs | jq -S '.paths | keys' > .../api-docs-baseline.json`; later 'diff ... shows no differences'.

expectations.text: Final report includes per-interface smoke-test results with URL and status alongside the per-item checklist table.
expectations.evidence: The final report has only the per-item checklist table. Smoke results are compressed into a prose Evidence cell for V2 ('Readiness UP. Products 200 (3)...') and 'all smoke checks pass' for V3, with no per-interface URL/status rows.

expectations.text: Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.
expectations.evidence: 'I didn't run anything ... Every outcome below comes from the isolated fixture scenario.md and is labelled [SIM]'; 'All results below are simulated'.

suggestions.assertion: Runs a smoke test after the test-only mvn clean verify item ...
suggestions.reason: The scenario order puts Approach A directly after clean verify, so the behavior is hard to tell apart from coincidence.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions 6 and 8 discriminate between runs; the others pass for both.
